original_hook: 🎯 When $IOST posts $52.5M in 24-hour quote volume and a massive 131.6% intraday range while dropping 21.75%, heavy volume isn't automatically a buy signal. This turnover profile points to a derivative liquidation cascade. Forced margin unwinds triggered automated sell orders, forcing spot market makers to absorb inventory at lower levels. While retail buyers stepped in anticipating a rebound, persistent sell pressure kept price suppressed near $0.00110. If this were true institutional accumulation, we'd expect an immediate V-bottom reversal. Consolidating below the $0.00115 volume baseline instead indicates stop-clearing distribution.
